youtube_description:
In this video I photograph M42, the Orion Nebula found in the constellation Orion using my William Optics ZS81 telescope.

Subs:
- 53 x 180s
- 11 x 120s
- 182 x 60s

Equipment:
- 🔭 William Optics Zennithstar 81 + Sky-Watcher HEQ5 Pro
- 📸 ZWO ASI 294MC Pro + Optolong L-eXtreme filter
- 🧭 William Optics 50mm Slide-base Uniguide Scope + ZWO ASI 120mm Mini
- 💻 ZWO ASIAir Pro

Please let me know your thoughts on the image in the comments and don’t forget to like & subscribe!
youtube_title: I Photographed the Orion Nebula with the William Optics ZS81 APO Telescope
